build_reshard_metadata: build reshard metadata from tensor size, sharding spec, and world size to produce shard metadata and rank ordering
reshuffle_local_shard: reshuffle a local shard using all2all when the reshard dimension matches the original sharding dimension
reshard_local_shard: reshard a local tensor using all2all when the reshard dimension differs from the original sharding dimension
test_get_idx_from_placements: test get_idx_from_placements to find the position of a current rank within a placements list
review_build_reshard_metadata: review build_reshard_metadata function that calculates offsets, shard sizes, and device placement for distributed sharding
